judges.name: Prince Adenola Adegbesan
judges.title: Host, Ikonetu
judges.description: Prince Adenola Adegbesan is a UK-based legal innovator and venture strategist serving as Project Lead of IkonetU, a global fundraising platform enabling African entrepreneurs to raise capital through 60-second video pitches. He is also Founder & CEO of InspireCraft Global Limited, advising organisations on AI governance and cross-border business transformation. A qualified barrister with venture capital experience, he is recognised for architecting systemic change most notably contributing to Nigeria's historic police reform, while building scalable, impact-driven ventures across Africa, the UK, and the United States.

judges.name: Anthony Rose
judges.title: Founder & CEO, SeedLegals
judges.description: Anthony is founder and CEO at SeedLegals, a legaltech platform that lets startup founders get investment ready, do a funding round, and complete the legals needed to build their business at a fraction of the cost of using a law firm. Over 50,000 startups use SeedLegals. Anthony's career has included 3D graphics, P2P music, internet video, social TV and heading up BBC iPlayer. Back in 2009 Wired Magazine's cover story billed him as The Man Who Saved The BBC.

judges.name: Venkatesh Bharti
judges.title: Founder, Vastav Intellect IP Solutions
judges.description: Venkatesh Bharti is a scientist, inventor, entrepreneur, and consultant known for his work in innovation, intellectual property, and technology commercialization. He has been recognized with the Young & Innovative Scientist Award by India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and has 80+ granted intellectual properties (IPs) across domains such as IoT, health-tech, legal-tech, and education technology. He is the founder and director of ventures like Vastav Intellect IP Solutions LLP and Vastav Incubatex & Entrepreneurship Foundation (VIEF), through which he provides strategic consulting on innovation and startups and mentors founders on IP strategy and commercialisation.

judges.name: Okeowo Temiloluwa
judges.title: Founder, Funnel Upscale LLC
judges.description: Okeowo Temiloluwa Emmanuel is a funnel strategist, automation expert, and founder of Funnel Upscale LLC, a digital growth agency focused on helping businesses turn traffic into leads and customers through high-performing sales funnels and automation systems. He has designed 150+ conversion-optimized funnels across more than 15 industries, leveraging tools like GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels to support sustainable business growth.

judges.name: Favour Ben
judges.title: Founder & CEO, Roots and Radiance Network
judges.description: Favour Ben is a business lecturer at Arden University and the Founder and CEO of Roots and Radiance Network CIC, a UK-based organisation dedicated to supporting hair, beauty, and creative entrepreneurs. Through this work, she promotes inclusive entrepreneurship by providing access to information, skills development, and opportunities that enable individuals to build and sustain thriving businesses in the UK.

judges.name: Busola Dakolo
judges.title: Founder, SkillsKitchen
judges.description: Busola Dakolo is a communications strategist, entrepreneur, and visual storyteller based in the UK. She holds a Master's degree in International Business from Loughborough University and a Diploma in Photography from the New York Film Academy. To strengthen the theoretical foundations of her practice, she is currently pursuing a PhD in Business and Management Studies. Busola is the Founder of SkillsKitchen, a training initiative that equips women and young people with practical, income-generating skills. She previously served as Head of Communications at Co-creation HUB (CcHUB), a pan-African creative and innovation ecosystem enabler, where her work shaped institutional narratives that supported entrepreneurship, technology adoption, and economic growth across the continent. With extensive experience advising startups on strategic communications, brand positioning, and storytelling, Busola supports early-stage founders in articulating clear and compelling value propositions, translating complex ideas into persuasive narratives that resonate with investors, partners, and broader audiences.

judges.name: Osayi Ebohon
judges.title: Transformational Speaker
judges.description: Osayi Ebohon is an award-winning transformational speaker, author of BecomingHer: A Mindset and Legacy Transformational Journal, and Convener of the BecomingHer community. With 27 years in social work specializing in adoption and 19 years in real estate, she empowers women globally to achieve financial independence, build wealth, and create lasting legacies through faith-driven mentorship and advocacy.

judges.name: Elizabeth Adediji
judges.title: Founder, The Abeke Brand
judges.description: Elizabeth Adediji is the founder and director of The Abeke Brand Limited, a UK-based fashion company specializing in accessories and clothing. She holds an MA in Fashion and Creative Pattern Cutting from Nottingham Trent University, where she developed expertise in sewing, tailoring, and innovative design. Through her freelance work and academic training, Elizabeth has demonstrated a strong commitment to the craft of fashion design, with particular emphasis on technical precision and aesthetic excellence. As a creative entrepreneur, she applies her specialized skills in pattern cutting and garment construction to deliver quality fashion pieces that reflect both her technical proficiency and creative vision.

judges.name: Dimmykiss
judges.title: Spoken Word Artist & Lawyer
judges.description: Dimmykiss is a Nigerian spoken word artist, poet, motivational speaker, and lawyer. He holds an LLB degree and is known for his engaging motivational content shared across social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube. Dimmykiss combines his legal background with his passion for creative expression to deliver thought-provoking messages that inspire and educate his audience. His unique approach blends humor with valuable life lessons, making him a popular voice among young Nigerians seeking motivation and personal development.

judges.name: Celine Ofori-Amanfo
judges.title: Founder & CEO, GroupGiftz
judges.description: Celine Ofori-Amanfo is the Founder and CEO of GroupGiftz and a seasoned startup advisor with 15 years of experience in innovation management. An alumna of HEC Paris, Harvard Business School Online, and Cornell, she specializes in executing business strategies from ideation to MVP. Celine is passionate about mentorship, business expansion, and empowering women in entrepreneurship.

judges.name: Dr Stephen Akintayo
judges.title: Chairman, SACI Holdings
judges.description: Dr Stephen Akintayo is the Chairman of SACI Holdings, a private equity and venture investment firm dedicated to backing high-growth companies including AI-enabled businesses and scalable ventures across Africa, the UK, and the US with a strategic focus on value creation and long-term impact. He is a serial entrepreneur, seasoned investor, and author of 45+ books on wealth creation and business strategy, known for building and exiting multiple successful enterprises across real estate, technology, digital marketing, and investment services. Previously the Founder and CEO of Gtext Holdings, a multinational conglomerate with diversified interests in real estate and technology, Dr Akintayo transitioned to a strategic leadership role to scale his investment vision and mentorship ecosystem.

judges.name: Mr Bola Ray
judges.title: CEO, EIB Network Group
judges.description: Mr Bola Ray (Nathan Kwabena Anokye Adisi) is a Ghanaian media entrepreneur, business leader, and visionary executive with over two decades of experience shaping Africa's media and entertainment landscape. As Chief Executive Officer of EIB Network Group and CEO of Empire Entertainment, he has led the growth of one of West Africa's most dynamic media conglomerates, spanning radio, television, digital platforms, and live events. Under his leadership, the EIB Network home to brands such as Starr FM, GHOne TV, and Live FM has become a pioneering force in broadcasting and content creation. Recognised for his leadership and influence, he has been appointed Country Board Chair for Ghana at the Global Entrepreneurship Festival 2025 and was the first inductee into The Creatives' Space of Fame, celebrating his lasting impact on the creative industries.

judges.name: Femi (S.O.A) Olukoya
judges.title: Global Managing Partner at GrapeVine360 Solutions Group
judges.description: Femi (S.O.A) is a purpose-driven, visionary leader with over 25 years' international experience in technology-enabled transformation, organizational strategy, and stakeholder engagement. He has a proven track record of guiding complex organizations through digital and operational change initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in performance, productivity, governance, and resilience. This includes over a decade at global magic circle law firm Linklaters- focused on bringing legal certainty to a changing world. He is a highly valued and trusted advisor on several boards, including an award-winning member of the renowned GEF (Global Entrepreneurship Festival) Board. He holds an MBA in International Business and a Bachelor of Engineering (Hons) in Electronic Engineering and is currently completing a Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) in Strategy and Innovation. His research focuses on comparative artificial intelligence strategies across governments, multinational organizations, and non-profit institutions, providing practical insight into emerging technology governance, risk, and ethical leadership.

judges.name: Dr. Kelly Daniels
judges.title: Relationship Consultant & Family Advocate
judges.description: Dr. Kelly Daniels is a relationship consultant and family advocate. Author of 85 books on love, marital, and family affairs. He is also a presenter on Ghana's prominent media corporation, the EIB NETWORK that  manages a number of radio and tv stations in active service to humanity. As an on air personality, Dr. Kelly Daniels is one of the most prolific  counselors on Ghana's media and has been serving for over a decade in service to the community and beyond. He is a serial conference host on love affairs within and outside Ghana, armed with a degree in counseling, a masters degree in counseling, and an honorary doctorate degree in Divinity. Dr. Kelly Daniels is a faith based person and as such is an itinerant preacher to multiple faith platforms, promoting the message of love and Christian living as a blessing to family life. As a passionate filmmaker and actor, Dr. Kelly Daniels has a structure in place to convert all his published books into movies, for better conveyance of the love message. Dr. Kelly Daniels believes that the world will gradually become a better place if we all selflessly love each other, at least one soul at a time. He is the founding head of LOVE NATION, the umbrella covering all initiatives birthed by him by God's grace.

judges.name: Shelley Cowan
judges.title: Founder & CEO, Access Avenue International Limited
judges.description: Shelley Cowan is a disabled female entrepreneur, tech founder, international speaker, and advocate for inclusion and accessibility, with over 30 years of lived experience navigating disability, health and engaging with communities, organisations, and industries to create meaningful change. She founded JustUs (group for adults with disabilities) and Access Avenue International Limited, developing platforms that empower underrepresented communities and create inclusive solutions for accessible travel. Shelley is Northern Ireland's first Purple Tuesday Ambassador, promoting enhanced customer experiences for people with disabilities, and serves as an advisor for the Accessible Hospitality Alliance. She has shared her expertise on accessibility and inclusion as a TEDx speaker at Black Mountain, and her work has been recognised with the Diversity in Tech Award and as a finalist for the National Diversity Awards Entrepreneur of Excellence. Shelley empowers diverse entrepreneurs and leaders to overcome barriers, scale their ventures and create real, global impact.

judges.name: Prof. Godwin Oyedokun
judges.title: Professor of Accounting and Financial Development, Lead City University, Ibadan
judges.description: Prof. Godwin Oyedokun is a distinguished scholar-practitioner with over 25 years of multidisciplinary experience in law, forensic accounting, taxation, financial development and public policy analysis. Currently a Professor of Accounting and Financial Development at Lead City University, Ibadan, he is widely respected for his contributions to academia and industry. Prof. Oyedokun was the Chief Executive Officer at OGE Professional Services Ltd, the company which is recognized for its expertise in accounting, tax advisory, and forensic auditors. Throughout his career, he has held several key roles, including Partner, Audit & Forensic Services at Ibrahim Jimoh & Co. Chartered Accountants, and Director of Tax, Forensic & Regulatory Services at Saffron Professional Services. He has also held leadership positions such as Audit Manager at Gbolahan Oyegoke & Co. (Chartered Accountants) and Accounts Manager (Head of Accounts) at Bond Chemical Industries Ltd, where he also served as Financial Accountant and Cost & Management Accountant. In addition, he was a Senior Analyst (Resident Control & Risk Officer) at XL Management Services Ltd. Earlier in his career, Prof. Oyedokun worked (for his industrial attachment) at the Bursary Department of the University of Ibadan, where he gained experience in the Correspondence, Assets & Insurance, and Payroll sections. In academia, Prof. Oyedokun has held adjunct positions at various prestigious universities, both in Nigeria and internationally. His extensive academic experience complements his practical knowledge, making him a highly sought-after educator and consultant in the fields of forensic accounting, financial development, and taxation. He has also played significant roles at the Chartered Institute of Taxation of Nigeria (CITN), where he led the Education, Research & Technical Directorate as well as the Finance & ICT Directorate. As an author, public policy analyst, and international speaker, Prof. Oyedokun continues to share his expertise across various platforms, influencing both policy and practice in the financial world. He is currently a Governing Council member of the Business Recovery and Insolvency Practitioners of Nigeria (BRIPAN), President of the Association of Forensic Accounting Researchers (AFAR), President of the Association of Tax Practitioners, Lagos, Nigeria and Council member/Director, Research & Development of Institute of Personality Development and Customer Relationship Management, Board Chairman of the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE, Southwest, Nigeria Chapter), Chairman, Board of Diplomates of Forensic Accounting & Audit of the Chartered Institute of Forensic and Certified Fraud Investigators of Nigerian (CIFCFIN), Chairman, Board of Trustees of Institute of Hospitality Accountants & Revenue Managers and Member of Board of Trustees of the Association of Management and Social Sciences Researchers of Nigeria. He is the Financial Secretary of the Association of Professional Bodies in Nigeria (APBN) and the Past Chairman, Ilupeju/Gbagada & District Society of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria (ICAN) among others.

judges.name: Dr Mayowa Gbenga
judges.title: Senior Lecturer in Business Management, Convenant University, Ogun
judges.description: Dr Mayowa Gbenga Agboola is a Senior Lecturer in Business Management with over eighteen years of experience in teaching, research, and academic leadership within the higher education sector. His expertise spans organisational behaviour, organisational culture, ethics, digital transformation, entrepreneurship, and technology-enabled learning, with a growing focus on artificial intelligence in education. He holds a PhD, MSc, and BSc in Business Administration and has undertaken extensive professional training in management, administration, consulting, and research. Dr Agboola has published in reputable peer-reviewed journals and international conference proceedings, contributing to scholarly discourse on organisational performance, innovation, and education systems. Dr Agboola has served in several senior academic and administrative leadership roles, including directorate and centre-level appointments in open and distance learning, research and innovation, lifelong learning, and entrepreneurship development. He is an experienced postgraduate supervisor and an advocate of student-centred, technology-driven pedagogy. He is an active member and fellow of recognised professional bodies, regularly serves as a journal reviewer and conference speaker, and contributes to academic initiatives aligned with global development priorities, particularly quality education, innovation, and decent work.

judges.name: Professor Wasiu Adeyemo
judges.title: Professor of Hotel Management and Tourism, Atiba University, Oyo, Nigeria
judges.description: Professor Wasiu Adeyemo Babalola is a distinguished academic, industry practitioner, and policy expert in hospitality and tourism development. He is a Professor of Hotel Management and Tourism at Atiba University, Oyo, Nigeria where he contributes to teaching, research, and capacity building in tourism, hospitality management, law, accoubtung, and related disciplines. Beyond academia, Prof. Babalola os the Senior Vice President for Africa at Continent Worldwide Hotels Turkiye and also serves as Chairman of the National Technical/Mirror Committee on Tourism and Related Services in Nigeria, where he plays a strategic role in aligning Nigeria's tourism standards and practices with international best practices. His work focuses on tourism regulation, quality assurance, sectoral reforms, and the integration of the private sector in national tourism development. With extensive experience spanning academia, professional practice, and policy engagement, Prof. Babalola is a respected voice on cultural tourism, hospitality entrepreneurship, and sustainable tourism development in Nigeria and beyond. He is a frequent speaker at conferences and media platforms, contributing thought leadership on the role of tourism in economic diversification and national development. He is a Rotarian and a Past Assistant Governor of District 9111 and Rotary Internation

judges.name: Dr Gbenga Eyiolawi
judges.title: Co-Founder & CEO, VISAROCRAFT Technology LLC
judges.description: Dr. Gbenga Eyiolawi is Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of VISAROCRAFT Technology LLC and Chairman of Tafiki a global food logistics brand where he has revolutionized Nigeria's agricultural technology and logistics sectors through innovative distribution models and supply chain optimization frameworks. With extensive expertise spanning agritech innovation and logistics management, his leadership has earned him recognition as one of Nigeria's Top 50 CEOs by The Guardian Newspaper (2023) and Lead City University's Most Outstanding CEO of the Year (2021 and 2022). With over two decades of transformative impact across agricultural value chains, Eyiolawi has pioneered consignment-based food distribution systems that bridge the gap between farmers and markets, introducing unprecedented operational efficiencies while expanding market access for agricultural products. His unique integration of technology-driven logistics solutions with traditional agricultural commerce has distinguished him as one of Nigeria's most exceptional innovators in the agritech and food distribution ecosystem, creating significant employment opportunities and driving youth empowerment initiatives nationwide.

judges.name: Stephen Camilleri
judges.title: Entrepreneur, Advisor & Capital Connector
judges.description: Stephen Camilleri is a globally experienced entrepreneur, advisor, and capital connector, he has spent his career supporting founders in building, scaling, and funding businesses across five continents. His work is driven by a clear mission which is to back bold entrepreneurs, foster cross border collaboration, and help transform strong ideas into sustainable, high impact ventures. He specialize in opening doors for visionary founders strengthening their brands, refining their strategies, and connecting them with capital through an established international network of investors. Over the past three years, his focus has been on expanding his global network and deepening his understanding of how businesses operate across diverse markets, including the UK, Europe, Africa, and the United States. This has given him first hand insight into the challenges, opportunities, and cultural nuances that shape entrepreneurial success in different regions. He is actively engaged in sectors including AI, film, fashion, events, energy, and entrepreneurship ecosystems, with a particular passion for innovation hubs and founder led communities. Alongside his commercial work, mentoring and supporting entrepreneurs has been a consistent thread throughout his career. As a collaborative and people driven leader, he is committed to sharing real-world experience to help others flourish. As a judge, he brings a practical, global, and founder first perspective assessing ideas not only on creativity, but on scalability, execution, and long term impact.

judges.name: Yaw Kyeremateng
judges.title: Head of Sales, Kuber Realty | Creative Director, The Yaw Brand | Cross-Border Real Estate Investment Specialist (UAE & Ghana)
judges.description: Yaw Kyeremateng is a Dubai-based real estate professional with over 10 years of experience in the UAE.He serves as Head of Sales at Kuber Realty, leading sales and marketing for Bella Vista, a gated community of 40 homes in Katamanso, Accra. Previously, he built a strong commercial foundation in retail home fashion and flooring, generating AED 30M+ in sales across 20 countries. Since transitioning into real estate, Yaw has closed AED 40M+ in property transactions, assisting 250+ clients in securing homes and investment properties in Dubai. He is also Creative Director of The Yaw Brand, a premium lifestyle label spanning fashion and fragrance. Focus areas: real estate sales and investment advisory, cross-border property (UAE–Ghana), sales strategy, and residential developments.

judges.name: Jim Keyes
judges.title: Former CEO of 7-Eleven and Blockbuster
judges.description: He is a seasoned business leader, author, and turnaround expert best known for serving as CEO of two iconic global brands: 7-Eleven and Blockbuster. At 7-Eleven, he led a remarkable transformation, driving record profitability, operational discipline, and sustained growth by empowering frontline employees and sharpening customer focus. He later took the helm at Blockbuster during one of the most disruptive periods in retail history, navigating the company through intense technological and market change while gaining deep insight into innovation, disruption, and leadership under pressure. Drawing from decades of executive experience, Keyes is the author of Education Is Freedom, a widely respected book that argues learning not background or circumstance is the ultimate driver of personal and professional success. Today, he is a sought-after speaker and advisor, helping leaders and organizations build resilient cultures, develop talent, and lead with clarity in rapidly changing environments.

judges.name: Ousseini Oumarou
judges.title: Cloud & AI Consultant
judges.description: OUSSEINI OUMAROU is a highly motivated Cloud and AI Consultant, uniquely positioned with a strong foundation in both Cloud computing and Artificial Intelligence. His expertise is validated by industry leading certifications. This robust skill set, combined with his background in Cryptocurrency, Web3, and Blockchain, allows him to architect and deploy innovative, scalable, and secure cloud native solutions, with a particular focus on leveraging advanced AI capabilities to drive transformative business outcomes. He is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology to create intelligent systems that redefine possibilities.

judges.name: Fisayo Areo
judges.title: Founder and CEO of signature puffs
judges.description: Fisayo Areo is a seasoned Confiseur/ pastry chef and the founder of signature puff which is a UK based pastry brand celebrating culture, flavour and community through freshly prepared West African comfort food. The brand is built on a passion for quality, consistency and creating pastries welcoming to all. She also continue to expand its menu with well loved favorites suitable for all.

judges.name: Deji Onadeko
judges.title: Founder & CEO, RedLantan Media
judges.description: Deji Onadeko is the visionary Founder & CEO of RedLantan Media, where creativity meets purpose. He believes in the power of storytelling to heal, inspire, and transform. As a filmmaker, coach, and speaker, Adedeji dedicates himself to inspiring others to live authentically while raising the standard of creativity and impact in every space he enters. Fueled by his love for life, Deji brings joyful, transformative energy to every project whether he's producing impactful media or mentoring individuals to become their most authentic selves.

judges.name: Henry Annafi
judges.title: Managing Director, Annafi Catalyst Solution
judges.description: Henry Annafi is Managing Director of Annafi Catalyst Solution, a consultancy specialising in inclusive leadership, intergenerational mentorship, and social value strategy. With 30 years of experience architecting systemic change, he has pioneered successful groundbreaking initiatives that returned marginalised people into education and employment. As Global Commercial Officer for HarvestCalc, an agritech platform empowering African smallholder farmers, he bridges inclusive business practices with continental impact. He chairs the Ambassadors Circle for The Veteran.UK and is an inspirational, award winning keynote speaker and published author. Henry is recognised for his proprietary H.E.N.R.I. Framework - a transformative approach to recruitment, retention, and organisational resilience that creates lasting social value.

judges.name: Sarah FitzMorris
judges.title: Founder and Board Member, Executives in Africa
judges.description: Sarah graduated from Oxford University in 1992 and worked briefly for Arthur Andersen before moving into professional finance recruitment for over ten years. Her career developed into emerging markets search in 2003 initially covering financial services in Russia and CIS. After extensive travel across East, West, and Southern Africa, Sarah focused solely on the African markets from 2008. She co-founded Executives in Africa with Richard Putley in 2010 and has since delivered over 300 search assignments across C-level, senior management, and technical roles. Her expertise spans financial services, fintech, payments, tech-enabled businesses, agribusiness, FMCG, and logistics sectors, and she remains hands-on with interviewing candidates on all the assignments she leads. Sarah regularly speaks at conferences as well as delivering online masterclasses.  She served for four years on the Global Council for 100 Women in Finance supporting them in building their networks across Africa.

judges.name: Prince Brutus Bamiteko
judges.title: Talent and Recruitment Strategist
judges.description: Prince Brutus Bamiteko brings a unique perspective combining education, talent development, and policy analysis. His experience as a teacher and policy analyst allows him to evaluate not only the viability of an idea but also its potential impact, scalability, and alignment with regulatory or societal frameworks.

judges.name: Vijay Jain
judges.title: Founder/CEO Transform-X GTM Strategist
judges.description: Vijay Jain a global leader having over 3 decades in developing go-to-market, enabling market entry, sales, and growth strategy across North America, EMEA, MENA, and India. He empowers startups, scale-ups, and established enterprises to unlock new markets, accelerate revenue, and build sustainable competitive advantage. A trusted advisor to technology solution providers especially in e-Governance, Smart Cities, Urban Planning, Digital Twins, and Capital Infrastructure he helps organizations navigate complex landscapes, win high-value contracts, and scale in government and infrastructure sectors. Through a flexible Fractional Leadership model, he delivers high impact strategic guidance that simplifies market entry, reduces risk, and accelerates growth without the overhead of full time executive hiring. He connects global companies to the right contract vehicles, partners, channels, and ecosystems, enabling them to compete and win in competitive markets, including the U.S. Public Sector. Focus areas include go-to-market strategy, global market access, sales enablement, and revenue acceleration.

judges.name: Eddy Acquah
judges.title: Licensed Real Estate Broker & Award-Winning Events MC
judges.description: Eddy Acquah is a licensed real estate broker by the Real Estate Agency Council and is a member of the Ghana Real Estate Professionals Association (GREPA) and Ghana Association of Real Estate Brokers (GAREB). He has over 9 years experience in sales and lettings of prime Accra residential and commercial properties as well as real estate research, investment and advisory. He is also an award-winning international  events MC who specialises in corporate events, weddings and social events with over 750 events hosted till date across Ghana, Lagos, Cape Town, Johannesburg, Virginia, Maryland, New Jersey, London and Dubai.

judges.name: Nancy Taiye Aragbaye
judges.title: Global Strategist and Diaspora Relations Advisor
judges.description: Nancy Taiye Aragbaye is a Global Strategist and Diaspora Relations Advisor who designs and executes high-impact platforms that connect Africa and the Diaspora for economic development, investment, and systems-level transformation. With over 15 years of experience spanning education, leadership development, entrepreneurship, and global engagement, Nancy advises foreign and local entities on how to unlock diaspora capital, talent, and influence to drive sustainable economic growth across emerging and frontier markets. She is the Founder of Strategic Solutions Global, an EdTech driven Global Leadership Institute, equipping senior and executive women ("LeadHERs") across Africa and the Diaspora with the tools, networks, and strategic frameworks required to lead at the highest levels of business, policy, and global commerce. Nancy's work sits at the intersection of: • Diaspora engagement & economic diplomacy • Leadership systems & institutional transformation • Global entrepreneurship & cross-border investment • Human Capital & Workforce Development  • Women's leadership pipelines & executive readiness Known for her ability to translate vision into execution, she brings deep expertise in organizational development, performance systems, program design, and ecosystem building, supporting governments, corporations, institutions, and global platforms in achieving measurable outcomes and long-term impact. As a global speaker and Pan-African thought leader, Nancy is trusted to deliver high-stakes keynotes, executive briefings, and strategic convenings that challenge outdated models and catalyze new pathways for economic mobility, leadership, and global collaboration. Her voice resonates across boardrooms, policy forums, and international stages where the future of Africa-Diaspora engagement is being shaped. Whether advising, building, or speaking, her mandate is clear: to architect scalable solutions that move communities, institutions, and nations forward.

judges.name: Dr Maddie Gomes
judges.title: Leadership & Consciousness Strategist, Board Advisor, Keynote Speaker
judges.description: Dr Maddie Gomes is a South Africa based leadership authority with over 35 years of experience spanning entrepreneurship, executive education, and human transformation. As a former Director of a Top 10 global Entrepreneurship Programme, she has shaped founders, executives, and innovators across continents, helping organisations build sustainable excellence in complex, high-pressure environments. A sought-after keynote speaker, author, and board advisor, Dr Gomes is known for bridging rigorous business strategy with deep inner leadership work. Her approach goes beyond performance metrics to address what truly sustains leadership over time: mental clarity, mindset alignment, and spiritual coherence. At the heart of her work is a powerful belief that the most effective leaders do not lead from unexamined trauma or inherited patterns, but from consciousness, purpose, and wholeness. Dr Gomes supports leaders and founders to integrate success with meaning, enabling them to lead with clarity, resilience, and profound human impact.

judges.name: Mark Eydman
judges.title: Founder and Lead Consultant, Six Pillars Consulting
judges.description: Mark Eydman is the Founder and Lead Consultant of Six Pillars Consulting, a UK-based advisory firm that helps organisations achieve sustainable, profitable growth by connecting customer insight, operational delivery, and governance discipline. He works closely with boards, leadership teams, and early-stage ventures to translate insight into practical action. Alongside his consulting work, Mark serves in a number of non-executive and advisory roles supporting founders and scale-ups, with a particular interest in early-stage governance, customer-led growth, and long-term value creation. He is actively involved in founder ecosystems across the UK and the USA and enjoys working with first-time entrepreneurs to help them think beyond the pitch and build credible, resilient businesses. Mark brings a thoughtful, constructive perspective to judging, grounded in real-world experience rather than theory.

judges.name: Victoria Victor
judges.title: Founder, Victorian Empowerment Foundation
judges.description: Victoria Victor is a transformational leadership strategist and economic empowerment advocate committed to raising leaders who build value, not just visibility. She is the Founder of Victorian Empowerment Foundation and the Lead Coach of Victorian Empowerment foundation Academy, Lead Coach of Business & Leadership Academy, platforms dedicated to equipping women and emerging professionals with practical skills, systems thinking, and enterprise intelligence. Through leadership development, tech-driven training, and strategic mentorship, she help individuals and institutions move from participation to ownership, designing businesses that create jobs, strengthen industries, and contribute meaningfully to national growth. Her work sits at the intersection of mindset transformation, economic design, and institutional leadership. Her mission is clear: to raise a generation of African leaders who think structurally, build sustainably, and shape economies with intention.

judges.name: Oludotun Akinwunmi
judges.title: Executive Head, Loveworld Institute of Innovation and Technology (LIIT)
judges.description: Oludotun Akinwunmi is a seasoned innovation and creative leader, currently serving as Executive Head at the Loveworld Institute of Innovation and Technology (LIIT). With a multidisciplinary background spanning media, technology, digital transformation, and youth capacity development, he has led initiatives focused on equipping emerging talents with future-ready skills and fostering innovation ecosystems across Africa. Oludotun is passionate about bridging creativity with technology to drive scalable solutions, and he brings extensive experience in leadership, program development, and cross-sector collaboration. As a judge for a few design and entrepreneurship projects, he contributes strategic insight, industry perspective, and a strong commitment to nurturing the next generation of innovators and entrepreneurs.

judges.name: Victoria Lebene Osafo-Nkansah
judges.title: Founder & CEO, The Skin Pop Shop and Spa | Founder, The VL Exposure
judges.description: Victoria Lebene Osafo-Nkansah is an award-winning actress, humanitarian, serial entrepreneur and a woman of God with a passion for driving social change and empowering communities. Born and raised in Cantonments, Accra, Ghana, she has become a multifaceted figure recognized for her dedication to addressing social and environmental issues within Ghanaian society. With a strong focus on leveraging communication for social development, Victoria excels in assessing risks and opportunities, entrepreneurship, social marketing, media advocacy, and community participation. She is deeply committed to using her skills to facilitate meaningful change, with a particular emphasis on empowering women and supporting grassroots initiatives. Victoria has honed a diverse skill set that aligns seamlessly with her career trajectory, including event presenting, hosting, and public speaking. Her ability to engage audiences and inspire action has made her a sought-after personality for key social initiatives and events. She is the Founder and CEO of The Skin Pop Shop and Spa, a natural skincare company, CEO of Vicky's recipe, a culinary haven for luxurious local jollof and the Founder of The VL Exposure, a non- profit organization dedicated to spotlighting SME's, young entrepreneurs, startups, industry leaders and individuals who seek innovative ideas for personal growth and development. Additionally, Mrs. Victoria leads Weight Loss Secrets by VL, empowering women to achieve transformative health and wellness goals as she has successfully done for herself. Victoria Lebene as popularly known has recently been appointed as a board member of the Global entrepreneurship Festival in Nigeria, following her ambassadorial role last year for which has led her to project businesses through influential platforms.

judges.name: Prof. Oluwasoye P. Mafimisebi
judges.title: Associate Professor & Reader in Strategic Management, Risk & Resilience, De Montfort University
judges.description: Prof. Oluwasoye P. Mafimisebi FCMI FHEA is an Associate Professor and Reader in Strategic Management, Risk & Resilience, and Faculty Head of Research at Leicester Castle Business School, De Montfort University, Leicester. A multi-award-winning scholar and academic entrepreneur, he leads research degree programmes in Business and Management and chairs the Faculty Research Degrees Sub-Committee. His scholarship spans strategic resilience, crisis management, FinTech innovation, African entrepreneurship, and SME finance in emerging economies. Before his academic career, he held senior leadership roles at Standard Chartered Bank, Diamond Bank Plc, and several leading insurance firms across Africa. A recipient of De Montfort University's Vice-Chancellor's Future Research Leaders Award, Prof. Mafimisebi bridges rigorous academic inquiry with real-world impact, championing sustainable entrepreneurship and business resilience across the Global South.

judges.name: Ayanda Ngwane
judges.title: Founder & CEO, Ayanda Media Network
judges.description: Ayanda Ngwane, widely known as the "Yaya of Africa", is a Pan-African media executive, journalist, television host, and strategic communicator whose work advances authentic African narratives across media, geopolitics, and development communication. Ayanda began her media journey with the South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) — where her early professional experience laid a strong foundation for continental and global storytelling. She has since built a distinguished career spanning over two decades across South Africa, West and Central Africa, and internationally. She is the Founder & Chief Executive Officer of Ayanda Media Network, a Pan-African content and strategy hub that produces impactful media, strategic communications, and development-oriented storytelling. As Host and Executive Producer of the acclaimed "Sharing with Ayanda" TV series, she convenes influential voices — including policymakers, cultural leaders, and innovators — in meaningful dialogues about leadership, development, and diplomacy. Ayanda holds key editorial and thought-leadership positions. Her international media work includes commentary on global affairs with platforms such as Russia Today (RT) and BRICS aligned outlets, elevating African perspectives on global governance and development. Beyond media production, Ayanda has delivered strategic communications and PR support for major continental platforms — including the World Economic Forum (Africa Chapter) and the African Women in Leadership Conference, spotlighting African leadership and innovation on global stages. Her leadership has earned multiple recognitions, including honours from the African Women in Leadership Organisation (AWLO), the African Leading Women Awards and accolades for Ayanda Media as the Fastest Growing Independent Media Production House at the Africa CEO Awards. Through her platforms and partnerships — including strategic collaborations designed to elevate African excellence on global business stages — Ayanda Ngwane continues to champion Pan-African integration, economic empowerment, and women's leadership in media and public discourse.

judges.name: Vasheti Quiros
judges.title: Founder, Well Balanced CEO
judges.description: Vasheti Quiros is an empowerment advocate, trauma-informed leadership coach, and expert fundraiser with over 20 years of experience helping nonprofits and soul-led entrepreneurs grow without burning out. As the founder of Well Balanced CEO, she support high achieving women leaders in reclaiming their energy, mastering financial abundance, and creating scalable impact on their own terms. She brings both strategy and soul to the table, combining fearless fundraising techniques with trauma-informed leadership to help you rise into the next level of visibility and success. She has been featured in The New York Times for her advocacy work, co-authored Women Who Lead, Volume 2, and have spoken on stages across North America to ignite real, lasting change in the nonprofit and entrepreneurial sectors.

judges.name: Confidence Chinwuko
judges.title: Cybersecurity Navigator, Digitanotion
judges.description: Confidence Chinwuko is a distinguished Cybersecurity Professional recognised for her expertise, research-driven approach, and passion for empowering others in the field. She serves as a Cybersecurity Navigator at Digitanotion, a mentor at NPower USA, and a lecturer at Peter University. With a strong blend of technical knowledge, academic experience, and consulting skills, Confidence is dedicated to fostering cybersecurity awareness and developing innovative solutions, positioning her as a trusted voice and respected authority in the industry.

judges.name: Tolulope Adeola Adebayo
judges.title: Founder, Divasity.com | Small Business Champion 2023 ICC-ITC-WTO MSME Group
judges.description: Tolulope Adeola Adebayo is a visionary, leader and change maker. He is the founder of Divasity.com a Technology Startup and marketplace for startup entrepreneurs to work on their businesses and access guaranteed funding. He also co-founded other startups. His passion is to inspire entrepreneurs to develop inclusive business models that contribute to social development. Through his organizations, he provides mentoring to over 100 young leaders and empowers an average of 20 entrepreneurs monthly through training and business development. He had a very early start working on businesses as a result of being raised by a mother who believed in taking her children through her business processes. This experience has cumulated in a 22 years experience of working with startups to build inclusive business models. His work has resulted in the facilitation of over 210,000 USD in cash/resources funding for these startups, majority of which were owned by female entrepreneurs. He has been involved in the development of over 20 projects from the idea stage. These projects include but not limited to business organizations, non-governmental organizations, library establishment, movie project, music project, books, departments, educational games, software, websites and so on. He is a certified entrepreneur participating in programmes of the University of Lagos Innovation 2 Market, Y Combinator Startup School, the Connak Foundation Entrepreneurship Initiative (COFEI) and Enterprise Development Centre, Lagos Business School. He has competences in Entrepreneurship | Business Development | Mentorship | Leadership Development | Team Building | Publishing | Writing | Public Speaking | Web Development | CMS Tools (Wordpress) | Blockchain

judges.name: Bisola Tijani
judges.title: Founder, Smart Money Group
judges.description: Bisola Tijani (WhizQueen) is a finance educator, entrepreneur, and founder focused on helping individuals and professionals build sustainable wealth through practical money strategies. As the founder of Smart Money Group and digital education programs, she simplifies complex financial concepts into actionable systems that drive long-term results. Over the past several years, she has built a trusted community educating thousands on investing, business structure, and financial discipline across Canada, Africa, and the diaspora. Her work bridges financial literacy and digital entrepreneurship, helping founders move beyond ideas into structured, profitable ventures. Bisola is passionate about equipping early-stage entrepreneurs with the financial clarity, building systems and decision-making frameworks required to build profitable businesses.

judges.name: Atuzie Favour
judges.title: Chief Light Bearer, Lightbulb Consults | TEDx Speaker
judges.description: Atuzie Favour "Tuzzi" (PMP, CCM, TEDx Speaker) is an internationally certified Project Management and Communications Consultant with over a decade of experience transforming vision into measurable outcomes. As Chief Light Bearer (CLB) of Lightbulb Consults, she leads a hybrid consultancy that merges structure and storytelling to deliver bespoke project execution and strategic communications solutions for organizations across Africa, Asia, Europe, and North America. Tuzzi has successfully designed, implemented, and managed over 100 projects, impacting 100,000+ stakeholders through partnerships with organizations such as UNICEF Nigeria, the GEF, SGF California, TOS, SLG and others. She specializes in funding utilization, program optimization, and stakeholder communication systems that enhance accountability, visibility, and long-term value. Recognized for her excellence and leadership, she has earned multiple awards and nominations across three continents, including the World MICE Awards and Leadership Africa Ambassadorship. She also serves on several advisory boards, lending expertise to community development, social innovation, and strategic planning. Beyond consulting, Tuzzi is a TEDx Speaker, known for her thought-provoking talk, "From Local to Limitless — Turning Here into Your Global Launchpad." She brings depth, warmth, and clarity to every room, teaching teams and organizations how to convert intention into execution. A PMP-certified, SCRUM Professional, and licensed CCM, Tuzzi blends precision with purpose - designing systems that scale sustainably and communicate effectively. Her leadership style champions excellence, empathy, and impact. She is open to senior advisory, program leadership, and partnership roles that advance innovation, governance, and organizational growth.
